pages.title: American Lion
pages.text: The American lion ($(o)Panthera atrox$()) is an extinct big cat that lived across North America, from Alaska to Mexico, during the Late Pleistocene, until about 12,000 years ago.$(br2)It was one of the largest cats that ever lived, noticeably bigger than the modern lion.$(br2)It was closely related to the Eurasian cave lion, and many of its remains have been recovered from the La Brea Tar Pits in California.
